title: Backend library dispatching for IO in Dask-Array and Dask-DataFrame
body:
This PR serves as a reference implementation for (what is expected to be) "Dask Design Proposal 1": https://github.com/dask/design-docs/pull/1

Required cudf branch for Dask-DataFrame dispatching to cudf: https://github.com/rjzamora/cudf/tree/backend-class
